1 test file takes over 10 s; the slowest, dist/test/trino-full.test.js, takes 603 s
8% of PR heads went green only on a rerun: track and fix flakes
A blocker most jobs wait on: "build" holds up 44 of 47 jobs, 166.5 job-min past their other needs; shorten it, or let them start setup and wait only for what they need
Jobs wait 347 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider

Split @cubejs-backend/shared#.: it re-exports 30 modules to at least 15 packages, so an edit to any of them reaches all of those packages' checks; give each area its own entry, listed by name, not `export *`
Move broad checks to a scheduled sweep
